key.name: taskbar-height
key.summary: Height of the taskbar in pixels

key.name: background-opacity
key.summary: Opacity of the taskbar background in percent (0 is fully see-through)

key.name: icon-size
key.summary: Size of the app icons in pixels

key.name: alignment
key.summary: Where the app icons sit: center (Windows 11) or left (Windows 10)

key.name: show-start-button
key.summary: Show the Ubuntu button that opens the app grid

key.name: show-pinned-apps
key.summary: Show pinned apps that are not running

key.name: show-tray
key.summary: Show the system tray (network, sound, battery and the system menu)

key.name: tray-spacing
key.summary: Space between tray icons in pixels

key.name: show-keyboard-indicator
key.summary: Show the keyboard layout indicator in the tray

key.name: show-a11y-indicator
key.summary: Show the accessibility indicator in the tray

key.name: show-app-indicators
key.summary: Show tray icons added by apps and other extensions

key.name: show-clock
key.summary: Show the clock (it also opens the calendar and notifications)

key.name: show-date
key.summary: Show the date under the time

key.name: time-format
key.summary: Time format (strftime); empty follows GNOME's 12 or 24 hour setting

key.name: date-format
key.summary: Date format (strftime); %x is your region's short date

key.name: clock-font-size
key.summary: Clock text size in points; 0 uses the default

key.name: show-task-view
key.summary: Show the Task View button, which opens the overview

key.name: show-desktop-button
key.summary: Show the thin Show desktop button at the right end

key.name: current-workspace-only
key.summary: Only show windows from the current workspace

key.name: hide-top-bar
key.summary: Hide GNOME's top bar (its tray and clock move to the taskbar either way)

key.name: hide-ubuntu-dock
key.summary: Turn off the Ubuntu Dock while the taskbar is on

key.name: blur
key.summary: Blur what is behind the taskbar (uses more graphics power)

key.name: app-order
key.summary: Order of the app buttons, as dragged by the user

key.name: tray-shown
key.summary: Tray icons always shown on the taskbar; the others go behind the ^ button

key.name: tray-known
key.summary: Tray icons seen so far (id, tab, name), listed in the settings window

key.name: docks-to-restore
key.summary: Docks this extension turned off, to turn back on when it is disabled
